rubric: Newest experience first; each job has title, employer, city, dates and 2 to 4 verb-first bullets with a result or number where possible.
The cover letter names the company and the job, gives two examples that match two requirements of the advert, and asks for an interview; 200 to 300 words.
Nothing invented: no employers, degrees, dates, numbers or certificates the user did not give; missing facts as placeholders.
Formal layout and greeting of the user's language and country; no buzzwords.
Three closing lines of advice (what to add, file name, what to check).

prompts.text: Write a cover letter for a customer support job at Bluewave Software. I worked 3 years in a call centre for a phone company, I speak English, German and Turkish, I like solving problems.

Rewrite this bullet so it sounds better: 'responsible for the warehouse'. I managed stock for 2,000 products and 5 people.
